Name: Micaiah, Son of Imla
Summary: Micaiah, son of Imla, was the prophet Jehoshaphat insisted on consulting before Ramoth-gilead; he foretold Israel scattered as sheep without a shepherd and Ahab's fall, and was imprisoned for it.
KeyStory: Micaiah saw the LORD on His throne and a lying spirit sent to entice Ahab, and declared that if Ahab returned in peace, the LORD had not spoken by him.
LifeLesson: A true prophet speaks what God says, even when four hundred others say the opposite.
